projects.description: DeepInfer: High-performance, large-scale inference framework for DeepSeek models
projects.readme_intro: DeepInfer is the high-performance inference framework that powers DeepSeek's large-scale production services. This open-source release provides offline inference with the core features needed for serving at scale. Supported models: - DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Supported features: - Optimized kernels, model and sampler runtime - Parallelism: Attention DP / balanced CP, MoE EP + EPLB - DSpark and confidence-scheduled verification - SWA bounded replay - Asynchronous scheduling (zero-overhead batch scheduler) - Batch-invariant inference - Deterministic sampling - Structured outputs Feature details and configuration - **Optimized kernels:** [FlashMLA](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/FlashMLA), [DeepGEMM](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepGEMM), [DeepEP](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepEP), [TileKer
